precept CustomerProfile

# A stateless data-only precept governing a single customer identity record.
# A customer profile holds contact details and communication preferences — it
# does not have a lifecycle of its own. Workflow precepts that interact with
# customers (orders, support tickets, billing) reference a profile by identifier
# and assume its data is valid at every read.
#
# All fields are editable — the host application's account-management UI is
# responsible for editing them. The rules below enforce the cross-field
# invariants that must hold at every read: marketing consent and preferred
# channel both require a stored, reachable address of the corresponding kind.
#
# PreferredContactMethod is optional with no default: a freshly created profile
# has no stated preference, so the preference-reachability rules below are
# vacuously satisfied until a channel is chosen. Once a preference is set, the
# rules enforce at every read that a matching contact address is stored.

field Name as string optional maxlength 200 editable
field Email as string optional maxlength 320 editable  # RFC 5321: 64-char local-part + "@" + 255-char domain
field Phone as string optional maxlength 32 editable
field PreferredContactMethod as choice of string("email","phone","sms") optional editable
field MarketingOptIn as boolean default false editable

rule MarketingOptIn == false or Email is set because "A profile cannot opt in to marketing without a stored email address — the host has no reachable channel for the promised communications"
rule PreferredContactMethod != "email" or Email is set when PreferredContactMethod is set because "Preferred contact method is email but no email address is stored — the preference is unreachable as written"
rule PreferredContactMethod == "email" or Phone is set when PreferredContactMethod is set because "Preferred contact method is {PreferredContactMethod} but no phone number is stored — the preference is unreachable as written"

precept InvoiceLineItem

# A stateless precept governing a single invoice line — unit price, quantity,
# discount, tax — together with the derived totals every billing system needs
# downstream. Source fields are editable (the host's invoice editor sets them);
# computed fields cannot be assigned and update atomically when their inputs
# change. There is no lifecycle: a line either is or isn't a valid line.
#
# Demonstrates the computed-field idiom (<-) in a data-only precept. The
# structural modifiers on the source fields (nonnegative, positive, max 100,
# maxplaces 2) are what make the computed totals provably non-negative — no
# separate runtime rules required.

field CurrencyCode as currency default 'USD' editable

# Source fields — directly edited by the host's line-editor UI.
field Description as string optional editable
field UnitPrice as money in '{CurrencyCode}' default '0 {CurrencyCode}' nonnegative editable
field Quantity as integer default 1 positive editable
field DiscountPercent as decimal default 0 nonnegative max 100 maxplaces 2 editable
field TaxRate as decimal default 0.08 nonnegative max 1 maxplaces 4 editable

# Computed fields — derived from source values at every read. Cannot be
# assigned; the formula is the single source of truth.
field Subtotal as money in '{CurrencyCode}' <- UnitPrice * Quantity
field DiscountAmount as money in '{CurrencyCode}' <- Subtotal * DiscountPercent / 100
field TaxableAmount as money in '{CurrencyCode}' <- Subtotal - DiscountAmount
field TaxAmount as money in '{CurrencyCode}' <- TaxableAmount * TaxRate
field LineTotal as money in '{CurrencyCode}' <- TaxableAmount + TaxAmount

text:
precept CrosswalkSignal

# A pedestrian crosswalk signal. A pedestrian presses the request button at
# any time; the signal honors the request on the next Advance from DontWalk,
# runs a Walk phase, flashes a decreasing don't-walk countdown, and returns
# to DontWalk. Without a pending request, an Advance from DontWalk is a no-op
# — the signal does not interrupt vehicle traffic without demand.
#
# Demonstrates: cross-cutting event (`from any on PedestrianRequest`), guard
# branching on a flag (RequestPending), and a decrementing countdown across
# successive Advance events.

field RequestPending as boolean default false
field CycleCount as integer default 0 nonnegative
field CountdownSeconds as integer default 0 nonnegative

state DontWalk initial
state Walk
state FlashingDontWalk

# State ensures — the field-level `nonnegative` modifier already prevents
# a negative countdown; the Walk-state floor here is stricter: zero is not
# enough to give the pedestrian time to cross.
in Walk ensure CountdownSeconds > 0 because "Walk phase must carry a positive countdown — a zero-second walk gives the pedestrian no time to cross before the signal flips"

# Editable window — the operator may pre-queue a request (e.g. a sensor sync
# or accessibility-button calibration) while the signal is in DontWalk.
in DontWalk modify RequestPending editable

# Events
event PedestrianRequest
event Advance

# ── Transitions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Pedestrian requests can arrive in any phase; they latch until honored.
from any on PedestrianRequest
    -> set RequestPending = true
    -> no transition

# DontWalk — Advance with a pending request opens the Walk phase with a
# 20-second countdown. Without a request, Advance is a no-op: the signal
# stays put and continues to favor vehicle traffic.
from DontWalk on Advance when RequestPending
    -> set RequestPending = false
    -> set CountdownSeconds = 20
    -> set CycleCount = CycleCount + 1
    -> transition Walk
from DontWalk on Advance
    -> no transition

# Walk → FlashingDontWalk with a 7-second flashing countdown.
from Walk on Advance
    -> set CountdownSeconds = 7
    -> set CycleCount = CycleCount + 1
    -> transition FlashingDontWalk

# FlashingDontWalk — each Advance decrements the countdown; when the counter
# would reach zero, the signal transitions back to DontWalk.
from FlashingDontWalk on Advance when CountdownSeconds <= 1
    -> set CountdownSeconds = 0
    -> set CycleCount = CycleCount + 1
    -> transition DontWalk
from FlashingDontWalk on Advance
    -> set CountdownSeconds = CountdownSeconds - 1
    -> no transition

precept LoanApplication

# A loan application from intake through funding. The applicant submits a
# complete file in a single event, the underwriter verifies documents, and
# the application is either approved (with an approved amount that may be
# less than the requested amount) and later funded, or declined with a note.
#
# Constructor pattern: Submit is marked `initial`, so the application arrives
# in UnderReview fully formed. There is no hollow Draft state — every loan
# record carries the applicant's intake fields from the moment it exists.
#
# Demonstrates: constructor pattern (Submit with `initial`), money type with
# enforced same-currency arithmetic, conditional rule (rule X when Y), a
# state-scoped editable window (DecisionNote becomes editable only after
# documents are verified), and a multi-factor approval guard combining
# document verification, credit policy, and affordability checks.

field ApplicantName as string notempty maxlength 200
field RequestedAmount as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD' nonnegative
field ApprovedAmount as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD' nonnegative
field CreditScore as integer default 300 min 300 max 850
field AnnualIncome as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD' nonnegative
field ExistingDebt as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD' nonnegative
field DecisionNote as string optional
field DocumentsVerified as boolean default false

# Phase timestamps — recorded by state-entry hooks (`to State -> set ...At = now()`)
# below, so the timestamp is captured on every inbound edge regardless of how
# the application reached the state. The construction event sets SubmittedAt
# directly because UnderReview is the initial state.
field SubmittedAt as instant
field ApprovedAt as instant optional
field FundedAt as instant optional
field DeclinedAt as instant optional

# Invariants
rule ApprovedAmount <= RequestedAmount because "Approved amount {ApprovedAmount} exceeds the submitted request of {RequestedAmount} — the bank cannot approve more than the applicant asked for"
rule ExistingDebt <= AnnualIncome * 3.0 when DocumentsVerified because "Existing debt {ExistingDebt} exceeds the 3x income ceiling — maximum allowed at {AnnualIncome} income is {AnnualIncome * 3.0}"

state UnderReview initial
state Approved
state Funded terminal
state Declined terminal

# State ensures
in Approved ensure DocumentsVerified because "Approved loan must have verified documents — approval cannot precede the verification step"
in Approved ensure ApprovedAt is set because "An approved loan must carry the approval timestamp"
in Funded ensure ApprovedAmount > '0.00 USD' because "Funded loan must carry a positive approved amount — a $0 funded loan is a bookkeeping error, not a disbursement"
in Funded ensure FundedAt is set because "A funded loan must record when the disbursement occurred"
in Declined ensure DeclinedAt is set because "A declined loan must record when the decision was made"

# DecisionNote becomes editable only after documents are verified — the
# underwriter cannot draft a decision rationale before the file is complete.
in UnderReview when DocumentsVerified modify DecisionNote editable

# Events
event Submit(
    Applicant as string notempty maxlength 200,
    Amount as money in 'USD' positive,
    Score as integer min 300 max 850,
    Income as money in 'USD' nonnegative,
    Debt as money in 'USD' nonnegative) initial

event VerifyDocuments
event Approve(Amount as money in 'USD' positive, Note as string optional)
event Decline(Note as string notempty)
event FundLoan

# ── Construction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
on Submit
    -> set ApplicantName = Submit.Applicant
    -> set RequestedAmount = Submit.Amount
    -> set CreditScore = Submit.Score
    -> set AnnualIncome = Submit.Income
    -> set ExistingDebt = Submit.Debt
    -> set SubmittedAt = now()

# ── Entry hooks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# State-entry timestamps fire automatically on every inbound transition into
# the named state, regardless of which row triggered the transition. This
# keeps the timestamp wiring in one place per state instead of scattered
# across every transition row that lands there.
to Approved -> set ApprovedAt = now()
to Funded -> set FundedAt = now()
to Declined -> set DeclinedAt = now()

# ── Transitions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

from UnderReview on VerifyDocuments
    -> set DocumentsVerified = true
    -> no transition

# Approval guard combines four underwriting checks: documents verified, credit
# floor (680), DTI floor (income at least 2x debt), and affordability ceiling
# (requested amount at most half of annual income). The Approve event also
# carries the underwriter's approved amount, which must not exceed the request.
from UnderReview on Approve when DocumentsVerified and CreditScore >= 680 and AnnualIncome >= ExistingDebt * 2.0 and RequestedAmount < AnnualIncome / 2.0 and Approve.Amount <= RequestedAmount
    -> set ApprovedAmount = Approve.Amount
    -> set DecisionNote = if Approve.Note is set then Approve.Note else if CreditScore >= 750 then "Prime tier — auto-approved" else "Standard tier — approved"
    -> transition Approved
from UnderReview on Approve
    -> reject "Approval requires verified documents (verified: {DocumentsVerified}), credit score 680+ (yours: {CreditScore}), and income at least double existing debt ({AnnualIncome} income vs {ExistingDebt} debt)"

from UnderReview on Decline
    -> set DecisionNote = Decline.Note
    -> transition Declined

from Approved on FundLoan
    -> transition Funded

precept InsuranceClaim

# An insurance claim moves from intake through document collection, adjuster
# review, approval (full or partial), payment, or denial. Claims may bounce
# between document collection and adjuster review before a decision is made.
# Fraud-flagged claims are capped at half the claim amount and require a
# decision note before approval. Approved claims pay out and reach Paid;
# denied claims terminate without payment, with an appeal path available.
#
# Demonstrates: money types with currency, set type for missing documents,
# lookup type for received documents and their status, conditional rules and
# state ensures keyed off a fraud flag, the omit pattern for fields that have
# no meaning before adjudication, and a Free-Construction Draft where the
# applicant fills the form before submitting.

# Claim identity
field ClaimantName as string optional maxlength 200
field PolicyNumber as string optional maxlength 50
field ClaimType as choice of string("Auto", "Property", "Liability", "Health") optional

# Monetary fields — money in 'USD' for exactness.
field ClaimAmount as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD'
field ApprovedAmount as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD'
field PaidAmount as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD'

# Adjuster + decision
field AdjusterName as string optional maxlength 200
field DecisionNote as string optional
field DenialReason as string optional

# Investigation flags
field PoliceReportRequired as boolean default false
field FraudFlag as boolean default false

# Document tracking — the missing-documents set tracks what the adjuster has
# requested but not yet received; the lookup tracks the status of every
# document the claim has touched.
field MissingDocuments as set of string
field SupportingDocuments as lookup of string to string

# Timestamps
field FiledAt as instant optional
field DecidedAt as instant optional
field PaidAt as instant optional

# Rules — domain invariants
rule ApprovedAmount <= ClaimAmount because "Approved amount {ApprovedAmount} cannot exceed the claim of {ClaimAmount}"
rule PaidAmount <= ApprovedAmount because "Paid amount {PaidAmount} cannot exceed approved amount {ApprovedAmount}"
rule ApprovedAmount * 2 <= ClaimAmount when FraudFlag because "Fraud-flagged claims are capped at half the claim amount ({ClaimAmount / 2})"

# States
state Draft initial
state Submitted
state UnderReview
state Approved
state Paid terminal
state Denied
state Appealed
state Closed terminal

# Fields with no meaning before adjudication.
in Draft, Submitted omit ApprovedAmount, PaidAmount, AdjusterName, DecisionNote, DenialReason

# Editable windows
in Draft modify ClaimantName, PolicyNumber, ClaimType, ClaimAmount, PoliceReportRequired editable
in UnderReview modify FraudFlag editable
in UnderReview when not FraudFlag modify AdjusterName editable

# State ensures
in Approved ensure ApprovedAmount > '0.00 USD' because "Approved claims must specify a positive payout amount"
in Approved when FraudFlag ensure DecisionNote is set because "Fraud-flagged approvals require a written decision note from the adjuster"
in Paid ensure PaidAmount > '0.00 USD' because "Paid claims must have a positive payment amount"
in Paid ensure PaidAt is set because "Paid claims must record the payment timestamp"
in Denied, Closed ensure DenialReason is set because "Denied claims must document the denial reason"

# Events
event Submit
on Submit ensure ClaimantName is set because "Claimant name is required before submission"
on Submit ensure ClaimAmount > '0.00 USD' because "Claim amount must be positive before submission"
on Submit ensure PolicyNumber is set because "Policy number is required before submission"

event AssignAdjuster(Name as string notempty maxlength 200)
event RequestDocument(Name as string notempty)
event ReceiveDocument(Name as string notempty)
event Approve(Amount as money in 'USD' positive, Note as string optional)
on Approve ensure Approve.Amount <= ClaimAmount because "Approved amount cannot exceed the claim amount"

event Deny(Reason as string notempty)
event Appeal(Reason as string notempty)
event PayClaim
event CloseClaim

# Submit — applicant pushes the claim from Draft. Police-report claims have a
# strict ceiling — submitting one above the cap is rejected outright.
from Draft on Submit when PoliceReportRequired and ClaimAmount > '100000.00 USD'
    -> reject "Police-report claims are capped at $100,000 (you submitted {ClaimAmount})"
from Draft on Submit
    -> set FiledAt = now()
    -> transition Submitted

# Assign adjuster — moves the claim into review.
from Submitted on AssignAdjuster
    -> set AdjusterName = trim(AssignAdjuster.Name)
    -> transition UnderReview

# Request document — adjuster flags a missing document.
from Submitted, UnderReview on RequestDocument when MissingDocuments contains RequestDocument.Name
    -> reject "Document {RequestDocument.Name} is already outstanding"
from Submitted, UnderReview on RequestDocument
    -> add MissingDocuments RequestDocument.Name
    -> put SupportingDocuments RequestDocument.Name = "Requested"
    -> no transition

# Receive document — close out the missing entry, mark the supporting status.
from UnderReview on ReceiveDocument when not (MissingDocuments contains ReceiveDocument.Name)
    -> reject "Document {ReceiveDocument.Name} is not currently outstanding"
from UnderReview on ReceiveDocument
    -> remove MissingDocuments ReceiveDocument.Name
    -> put SupportingDocuments ReceiveDocument.Name = "Received"
    -> no transition

# Approve — police-report claims need all documents in. Fraud-flagged approvals
# cap the payout at half the claim amount, expressed inline.
from UnderReview on Approve when PoliceReportRequired and MissingDocuments.count > 0
    -> reject "Required documents must be complete before a police-report claim can be approved (missing: {MissingDocuments.count})"
from UnderReview on Approve
    -> set ApprovedAmount = if FraudFlag then min(Approve.Amount, ClaimAmount / 2) else Approve.Amount
    -> set DecisionNote = if Approve.Note is set then Approve.Note else "Approved"
    -> set DecidedAt = now()
    -> transition Approved

# Deny — adjuster rejects the claim.
from UnderReview on Deny
    -> set DenialReason = Deny.Reason
    -> set DecisionNote = Deny.Reason
    -> set DecidedAt = now()
    -> transition Denied

# Pay claim — approved claims pay out.
from Approved on PayClaim
    -> set PaidAmount = ApprovedAmount
    -> set PaidAt = now()
    -> transition Paid

# Appeal — denied claims can be appealed once. Without an appeal, the
# claimant must close the claim explicitly to reach a terminal state.
from Denied on Appeal
    -> set DecisionNote = Appeal.Reason
    -> transition Appealed
from Denied on CloseClaim
    -> transition Closed

# After appeal — adjuster can re-approve (with the same checks) or close
# the claim with a final denial reason.
from Appealed on Approve
    -> set ApprovedAmount = if FraudFlag then min(Approve.Amount, ClaimAmount / 2) else Approve.Amount
    -> set DecisionNote = if Approve.Note is set then Approve.Note else "Approved on appeal"
    -> set DecidedAt = now()
    -> transition Approved
from Appealed on Deny
    -> set DenialReason = Deny.Reason
    -> set DecisionNote = Deny.Reason
    -> set DecidedAt = now()
    -> transition Closed

precept InventoryItem

# Ecommerce product inventory demonstrating Precept's full type system:
# money/price/quantity with dimensional analysis, exchange-rate currency
# conversion, computed P&L via derived fields, choice-typed valuation method,
# append-only audit logs, and a derived replenishment signal.
#
# Supports products in any dimension — count (each/cs), length (m/roll/in),
# mass (kg/bag/g), volume (L/bottle/mL), etc. Each quantity field's dimension
# is derived dynamically from the associated UoM field via `of '{X.dimension}'`
# so a product stocked by the roll, purchased by the case, and sold by the
# inch is handled correctly at the type level.
#
# Supplier invoices may arrive in any currency; an exchange rate converts to
# the catalog currency at receipt time. The catalog currency itself is
# configurable per product and locked at listing.
#
# Free-Construction: the item is created Unlisted and the user fills the SKU,
# unit system, currencies, valuation method, and initial list price via direct
# field edits (the `modify ... editable` declaration on Unlisted). The Publish
# event promotes the item to Listed once the data is complete. Per-item unit
# configuration cannot be carried in a single initial event because the
# inter-field qualifier references on the conversion quantities depend on the
# unit fields themselves being set first.
#
# Replenishment is a derived signal (IsLowStock), not a lifecycle state — the
# host inspects it on every read and drives alerts without requiring the
# precept to model "low stock" as a separate location in the state machine.

# ── Product identity ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
field Sku as string optional maxlength 50
field Description as string optional maxlength 200
field Supplier as string optional maxlength 100

# ── Currency ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
field CatalogCurrency as currency default 'USD'
field SupplierCurrency as currency default 'USD'
field ValuationMethod as choice of string("WAC") default "WAC"

# ── Units of measure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
field StockingUnit as unitofmeasure default 'each'
field PurchaseUnit as unitofmeasure default 'each'
field SaleUnit as unitofmeasure default 'each'

field StockingUnitsPerPurchaseUnit as quantity in '{StockingUnit}/{PurchaseUnit}' default '1 {StockingUnit}/{PurchaseUnit}' positive
field StockingUnitsPerSaleUnit as quantity in '{StockingUnit}/{SaleUnit}' default '1 {StockingUnit}/{SaleUnit}' positive

# ── Stock levels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
field QuantityOnHand as quantity of '{StockingUnit.dimension}' default '0 {StockingUnit}' nonnegative
field RestockThreshold as quantity of '{StockingUnit.dimension}' default '0 {StockingUnit}' nonnegative

# Derived replenishment signal — drives the host's restocking alerts without
# requiring a separate lifecycle state.
field IsLowStock as boolean <- QuantityOnHand <= RestockThreshold

# ── Pricing and cost ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
field TotalInventoryCost as money in '{CatalogCurrency}' default '0 {CatalogCurrency}' nonnegative

# Weighted average cost per stocking unit — purchase side, derived from shipment receipts.
field AverageCost as price in '{CatalogCurrency}' of '{StockingUnit.dimension}' default '0 {CatalogCurrency}/{StockingUnit}' nonnegative

# List price per sale unit — selling side, set explicitly via UpdateListPrice.
field ListPrice as price in '{CatalogCurrency}' of '{SaleUnit.dimension}' default '0 {CatalogCurrency}/{SaleUnit}' nonnegative

# Realized P&L accumulators — captured per event.
field TotalRevenue as money in '{CatalogCurrency}' default '0 {CatalogCurrency}' nonnegative
field TotalCostOfGoods as money in '{CatalogCurrency}' default '0 {CatalogCurrency}' nonnegative
field TotalReturns as money in '{CatalogCurrency}' default '0 {CatalogCurrency}' nonnegative
field TotalShrinkage as money in '{CatalogCurrency}' default '0 {CatalogCurrency}' nonnegative

# GrossProfit is derived — the engine keeps it atomically consistent with the accumulators.
field GrossProfit as money in '{CatalogCurrency}' <- TotalRevenue - TotalReturns - TotalCostOfGoods - TotalShrinkage

# Number of list-price changes since listing — useful for pricing audit and SLA tracking.
field PriceChangeCount as integer default 0 nonnegative

# Append-only audit logs.
field ShrinkageLog as log of string
field AdjustmentLog as log of string

# ── States ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
state Unlisted initial
state Listed
state Delisted

# ── Editable windows ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Unit system, catalog currency, and valuation method are configured before
# listing and locked thereafter. Pricing and supplier details remain editable.
in Unlisted modify Sku, CatalogCurrency, SupplierCurrency, ValuationMethod, StockingUnit, PurchaseUnit, SaleUnit, StockingUnitsPerPurchaseUnit, StockingUnitsPerSaleUnit, ListPrice, Supplier editable
in Listed modify RestockThreshold, Supplier, SupplierCurrency editable

# ── State ensures ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
in Listed ensure Sku is set because "A listed product must carry a SKU — the catalog identifier is how every other system references this item"
in Listed ensure ListPrice > '0 {CatalogCurrency}/{SaleUnit}' because "A listed product must have a positive list price — a zero-priced listing is not a sellable record"
in Listed ensure ListPrice / StockingUnitsPerSaleUnit >= AverageCost because "List price per stocking unit {ListPrice} is below average cost {AverageCost} — selling at a structural loss is not allowed without an explicit markdown"
in Listed ensure QuantityOnHand > '0 {StockingUnit}' and AverageCost > '0 {CatalogCurrency}/{StockingUnit}' or QuantityOnHand == '0 {StockingUnit}' because "Stocked items must have a positive average cost — zero cost with positive stock means valuation has drifted from receipts"

# ── Events ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
event Publish(InitialListPrice as price in '{CatalogCurrency}' of '{SaleUnit.dimension}', Desc as string optional maxlength 200)
on Publish ensure Publish.InitialListPrice > '0 {CatalogCurrency}/{SaleUnit}' because "Initial list price must be positive — a zero-priced listing is not a sellable record"

event ReceiveShipment(
    PurchaseQty as quantity of '{PurchaseUnit.dimension}',
    SupplierUnitCost as price in '{SupplierCurrency}' of '{StockingUnit.dimension}',
    Rate as exchangerate in '{SupplierCurrency}' to '{CatalogCurrency}')
on ReceiveShipment ensure ReceiveShipment.PurchaseQty > '0 {PurchaseUnit}' because "Purchase quantity must be positive — a zero-quantity receipt is not a receipt"
on ReceiveShipment ensure ReceiveShipment.SupplierUnitCost > '0 {SupplierCurrency}/{StockingUnit}' because "Supplier unit cost must be positive — a zero-cost shipment would corrupt the weighted-average cost"

event FulfillOrder(Qty as quantity of '{SaleUnit.dimension}')
on FulfillOrder ensure FulfillOrder.Qty > '0 {SaleUnit}' because "Order quantity must be positive — a zero-quantity fulfillment is not an order"

event ReturnOrder(
    Qty as quantity of '{SaleUnit.dimension}',
    OriginalSalePrice as price in '{CatalogCurrency}' of '{SaleUnit.dimension}')
on ReturnOrder ensure ReturnOrder.Qty > '0 {SaleUnit}' because "Return quantity must be positive — a zero-quantity return is not a return"
on ReturnOrder ensure ReturnOrder.OriginalSalePrice > '0 {CatalogCurrency}/{SaleUnit}' because "Original sale price must be positive — a zero-priced original sale would invalidate the revenue reversal"

event AdjustInventory(
    Qty as quantity of '{StockingUnit.dimension}' default '0 {StockingUnit}',
    Note as string notempty)
on AdjustInventory ensure AdjustInventory.Qty >= '0 {StockingUnit}' because "Adjusted quantity cannot be negative — a cycle count is a physical observation, not a debit"

event RecordShrinkage(
    Qty as quantity of '{StockingUnit.dimension}',
    Reason as string notempty)
on RecordShrinkage ensure RecordShrinkage.Qty > '0 {StockingUnit}' because "Shrinkage quantity must be positive — a zero-quantity write-off is not a write-off"
on RecordShrinkage ensure RecordShrinkage.Qty <= QuantityOnHand because "Cannot write off {RecordShrinkage.Qty} when only {QuantityOnHand} is on hand — shrinkage cannot exceed physical stock"

event UpdateListPrice(NewPrice as price in '{CatalogCurrency}' of '{SaleUnit.dimension}')
on UpdateListPrice ensure UpdateListPrice.NewPrice > '0 {CatalogCurrency}/{SaleUnit}' because "List price must be positive — a zero-priced listing is not a sellable record"

event Delist(Reason as string optional maxlength 200)
event Relist

# ── Transitions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Sku presence is guaranteed by the Listed state ensure, but the proof engine
# does not currently narrow state-ensure facts across a transition body. (Event-
# ensure narrowing is in place; state-ensure narrowing across transitions is a
# separate, still-open limitation.) Guard explicitly until that gap closes.
from Unlisted on Publish when Sku is set
    -> set ListPrice = Publish.InitialListPrice
    -> set Description = if Publish.Desc is set then Publish.Desc else Sku
    -> transition Listed
from Unlisted on Publish
    -> reject "Sku must be set on the draft before publishing — the catalog cannot list an item without an identifier"

# ReceiveShipment: convert supplier cost to catalog currency, update WAC.
from Listed on ReceiveShipment
    -> set TotalInventoryCost = TotalInventoryCost + ReceiveShipment.Rate * (ReceiveShipment.SupplierUnitCost * (ReceiveShipment.PurchaseQty * StockingUnitsPerPurchaseUnit))
    -> set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand + ReceiveShipment.PurchaseQty * StockingUnitsPerPurchaseUnit
    -> set AverageCost = (TotalInventoryCost + ReceiveShipment.Rate * (ReceiveShipment.SupplierUnitCost * (ReceiveShipment.PurchaseQty * StockingUnitsPerPurchaseUnit))) / (QuantityOnHand + ReceiveShipment.PurchaseQty * StockingUnitsPerPurchaseUnit)
    -> no transition

# FulfillOrder: capture P&L at current prices before decrementing stock.
from Listed on FulfillOrder when QuantityOnHand >= FulfillOrder.Qty * StockingUnitsPerSaleUnit
    -> set TotalRevenue = TotalRevenue + FulfillOrder.Qty * ListPrice
    -> set TotalCostOfGoods = TotalCostOfGoods + FulfillOrder.Qty * StockingUnitsPerSaleUnit * AverageCost
    -> set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand - FulfillOrder.Qty * StockingUnitsPerSaleUnit
    -> set TotalInventoryCost = QuantityOnHand * AverageCost
    -> no transition
from Listed on FulfillOrder
    -> reject "Insufficient stock to fulfill {FulfillOrder.Qty} — only {QuantityOnHand} on hand"

# ReturnOrder: reverse revenue at original price; reverse COGS at current WAC.
from Listed on ReturnOrder
    -> set TotalReturns = TotalReturns + ReturnOrder.Qty * ReturnOrder.OriginalSalePrice
    -> set TotalCostOfGoods = TotalCostOfGoods - ReturnOrder.Qty * StockingUnitsPerSaleUnit * AverageCost
    -> set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand + ReturnOrder.Qty * StockingUnitsPerSaleUnit
    -> set TotalInventoryCost = QuantityOnHand * AverageCost
    -> no transition

# AdjustInventory: cycle count sync — no P&L accumulator impact.
from Listed on AdjustInventory
    -> set QuantityOnHand = AdjustInventory.Qty
    -> set TotalInventoryCost = AdjustInventory.Qty * AverageCost
    -> append AdjustmentLog AdjustInventory.Note
    -> no transition

# RecordShrinkage: write-off — books cost to TotalShrinkage, appends reason.
from Listed on RecordShrinkage
    -> set TotalShrinkage = TotalShrinkage + RecordShrinkage.Qty * AverageCost
    -> set QuantityOnHand = QuantityOnHand - RecordShrinkage.Qty
    -> set TotalInventoryCost = QuantityOnHand * AverageCost
    -> append ShrinkageLog RecordShrinkage.Reason
    -> no transition

from Listed on UpdateListPrice
    -> set ListPrice = UpdateListPrice.NewPrice
    -> set PriceChangeCount = PriceChangeCount + 1
    -> no transition

from Listed on Delist when Delist.Reason is set
    -> set Description = Delist.Reason
    -> transition Delisted
from Listed on Delist
    -> transition Delisted

from Delisted on Relist
    -> transition Listed

precept LibraryBookCheckout

# A library book moving through circulation: from the shelf, out to a borrower,
# overdue if it goes past its due day, returned for inspection, shelved back to
# the shelf, or written off as lost. Fines accrue while the book is overdue and
# are settled on return or loss resolution.
#
# Free-Construction: a book exists on the shelf as a long-lived artifact —
# title is filled in via direct edit on Available before the first checkout.
# Renewal is capped at two extensions per loan; the day counter is monotone
# and drives the Overdue transition automatically.

# Identity — set once on the shelf, edited in Available.
field BookTitle as string optional maxlength 200

# Loan party — populated by Checkout, cleared on exit from CheckedOut/Overdue/Lost.
field BorrowerId as string optional maxlength 100

# Monotone day counter — advanced by AdvanceDay events; never decreases.
field CurrentDay as integer default 0 nonnegative
field CheckoutDay as integer default 0 nonnegative
field DueDay as integer default 0 nonnegative

# Renewal cap is enforced by the guard `RenewalCount < 2` on the renewal row
# plus the runtime rule below. A field-level `max 2` modifier could express
# the bound structurally; the runtime rule is kept here as the authoritative
# enforcement (the rule fires regardless of dispatch path and survives any
# future restructuring of the renewal flow).
field RenewalCount as integer default 0 nonnegative
rule RenewalCount <= 2 because "RenewalCount {RenewalCount} exceeds the per-loan renewal cap of 2 — additional extensions require staff override, not patron self-service"

# Outstanding fines — accumulate while overdue, settled on Shelve / ResolveLoss.
field FineAmount as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD' nonnegative

# Condition note set at return or loss report, cleared on shelving.
field ConditionNote as string optional

# States
state Available initial
state CheckedOut
state Overdue
state Returned
state Lost

# Editable windows — staff may rename a book on the shelf, adjust loan dates
# while a loan is active, and revise the fine total when settling an overdue.
in Available modify BookTitle editable
in CheckedOut modify DueDay editable
in Overdue modify DueDay, FineAmount editable

# BorrowerId is meaningful only while a book is out, overdue, or lost — every
# circulation cycle starts and ends without a patron attached.
in Available, Returned omit BorrowerId

# State ensures
in CheckedOut ensure BorrowerId is set because "A checked-out book must record the borrower — the library cannot release a copy without a known patron"
in Overdue ensure BorrowerId is set because "An overdue book must still record the borrower — fine collection cannot happen anonymously"
in Overdue ensure CurrentDay > DueDay because "An overdue book must be past its due day — CurrentDay {CurrentDay} is not yet past DueDay {DueDay}"
in Lost ensure BorrowerId is set because "A lost book must still record the borrower of record — accountability for the loss attaches to the last patron who held it"

# Exit-clear hook — leaving CheckedOut/Overdue/Lost back toward Returned or
# Available drops the borrower so the next state's `omit` invariant holds.
from CheckedOut, Overdue, Lost -> clear BorrowerId

# Events
event Checkout(
    PatronId as string notempty maxlength 100,
    LoanDays as integer positive)

event Renew(ExtraDays as integer positive)

event AdvanceDay(DayNumber as integer nonnegative)

event ReturnBook(Condition as string optional)
event ReportLost(Note as string optional)
event Shelve
event ResolveLoss(SettlementAmount as money in 'USD')
on ResolveLoss ensure ResolveLoss.SettlementAmount >= '0.00 USD' because "Settlement amount cannot be negative — a loss resolution credits or zeroes the fine, never reverses it"

# ── Transitions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

from Available on Checkout
    -> set BorrowerId = Checkout.PatronId
    -> set CheckoutDay = CurrentDay
    -> set DueDay = CurrentDay + Checkout.LoanDays
    -> set RenewalCount = 0
    -> set FineAmount = '0.00 USD'
    -> clear ConditionNote
    -> transition CheckedOut

# Renewal — guarded by the renewal cap and "not yet overdue" condition.
from CheckedOut on Renew when RenewalCount < 2 and CurrentDay <= DueDay
    -> set DueDay = DueDay + Renew.ExtraDays
    -> set RenewalCount = RenewalCount + 1
    -> no transition
from CheckedOut on Renew
    -> reject "Cannot renew loan — renewal cap reached ({RenewalCount}/2) or loan already past DueDay {DueDay}"

# AdvanceDay is monotone — refuse to move backwards.
from CheckedOut on AdvanceDay when AdvanceDay.DayNumber > CurrentDay and AdvanceDay.DayNumber <= DueDay
    -> set CurrentDay = AdvanceDay.DayNumber
    -> no transition
from CheckedOut on AdvanceDay when AdvanceDay.DayNumber > DueDay
    -> set CurrentDay = AdvanceDay.DayNumber
    -> transition Overdue
from CheckedOut on AdvanceDay
    -> reject "Day counter must move forward — AdvanceDay.DayNumber {AdvanceDay.DayNumber} is not after CurrentDay {CurrentDay}"

from Overdue on AdvanceDay when AdvanceDay.DayNumber > CurrentDay
    -> set CurrentDay = AdvanceDay.DayNumber
    -> no transition
from Overdue on AdvanceDay
    -> reject "Day counter must move forward — AdvanceDay.DayNumber {AdvanceDay.DayNumber} is not after CurrentDay {CurrentDay}"

# Return — staff inspects condition; the book sits in Returned for shelving.
from CheckedOut, Overdue on ReturnBook
    -> set ConditionNote = if ReturnBook.Condition is set then ReturnBook.Condition else "Good"
    -> transition Returned

from CheckedOut, Overdue on ReportLost
    -> set ConditionNote = if ReportLost.Note is set then ReportLost.Note else "Reported lost"
    -> transition Lost

# Shelving zeroes the loan state — the copy returns to the shelf for the next patron.
from Returned on Shelve
    -> set CheckoutDay = 0
    -> set DueDay = 0
    -> set RenewalCount = 0
    -> set FineAmount = '0.00 USD'
    -> clear ConditionNote
    -> transition Available

# Loss resolution — the patron settles, the title is retired from active circulation.
from Lost on ResolveLoss
    -> set FineAmount = ResolveLoss.SettlementAmount
    -> set CheckoutDay = 0
    -> set DueDay = 0
    -> set RenewalCount = 0
    -> clear ConditionNote
    -> transition Available

precept HiringPipeline

# A candidate moving through a hiring funnel: filled out by the recruiter on
# the shelf, screened by the recruiting team, run through an interview loop
# with a tracked panel of interviewers, decided on, offered, and either hired
# or rejected. The pipeline shows how a real-world workflow benefits from
# Precept's lifecycle model — each state activates a distinct rule set, and
# the panel of pending interviewers is a first-class set field that
# transitions cannot leave underpopulated.
#
# Free-Construction: a candidate enters in Draft and the recruiter fills in
# the name, role, and recruiter via direct edits. Submit promotes the record
# into Screening once those three fields are filled.

field CandidateName as string optional maxlength 100
field RoleName as string optional maxlength 100
field RecruiterName as string optional maxlength 100
field FeedbackCount as integer default 0 nonnegative
field OfferAmount as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD' nonnegative
field FinalNote as string optional
field PendingInterviewers as set of string

state Draft initial
state Screening
state InterviewLoop
state Decision
state OfferExtended
state Hired terminal
state Rejected terminal

# Editable window — recruiter fills the candidate intake fields before Submit.
in Draft modify CandidateName, RoleName, RecruiterName editable

# State ensures
in InterviewLoop ensure PendingInterviewers.count > 0 because "Interview loop requires at least one pending interviewer — a loop with no panel cannot collect feedback"
in Hired ensure OfferAmount > '0.00 USD' because "Hired candidate must carry a positive offer amount — a $0 hire is a record-keeping error, not a compensation decision"

# Events
event Submit
event AddInterviewer(Name as string notempty maxlength 100)
event PassScreen
event RecordInterviewFeedback(Interviewer as string notempty maxlength 100)
event ExtendOffer(Amount as money in 'USD' positive)
event AcceptOffer
event RejectCandidate(Note as string notempty)

# ── Transitions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Submit guards on completeness — Draft holds the intake fields editable; Submit
# checks they are all set before promoting into the screening lane.
from Draft on Submit when CandidateName is set and RoleName is set and RecruiterName is set
    -> transition Screening
from Draft on Submit
    -> reject "A complete application needs a candidate name, role, and recruiter — fill in the three Draft fields before submitting"

# Screening builds the interview panel via AddInterviewer; PassScreen promotes
# only once at least one interviewer is on the panel.
from Screening on AddInterviewer
    -> add PendingInterviewers AddInterviewer.Name
    -> no transition
from Screening on PassScreen when PendingInterviewers.count > 0
    -> transition InterviewLoop
from Screening on PassScreen
    -> reject "At least one interviewer must be assigned before the interview loop begins — add a panelist via AddInterviewer first"

# Rejection is allowed from any active review stage, with the reason captured.
from Screening, InterviewLoop, Decision on RejectCandidate
    -> set FinalNote = RejectCandidate.Note
    -> transition Rejected

# Interview loop — each panelist's feedback removes them from the pending set.
# The two-row pattern lets the final feedback close the loop into Decision; an
# earlier feedback leaves the candidate in InterviewLoop with the panel narrowed.
from InterviewLoop on RecordInterviewFeedback when PendingInterviewers contains RecordInterviewFeedback.Interviewer and PendingInterviewers.count == 1
    -> remove PendingInterviewers RecordInterviewFeedback.Interviewer
    -> set FeedbackCount = FeedbackCount + 1
    -> transition Decision
from InterviewLoop on RecordInterviewFeedback when PendingInterviewers contains RecordInterviewFeedback.Interviewer
    -> remove PendingInterviewers RecordInterviewFeedback.Interviewer
    -> set FeedbackCount = FeedbackCount + 1
    -> no transition
from InterviewLoop on RecordInterviewFeedback
    -> reject "Only assigned interviewers can submit feedback — {RecordInterviewFeedback.Interviewer} is not on the current panel"

# Decision — an offer requires at least two completed feedback entries. The
# tier note is set inline based on the feedback count (a richer signal would
# come from a calibration committee, but this captures the structural pattern).
from Decision on ExtendOffer when FeedbackCount >= 2
    -> set OfferAmount = ExtendOffer.Amount
    -> set FinalNote = if FeedbackCount >= 3 then "Strong Hire" else "Standard Hire"
    -> transition OfferExtended
from Decision on ExtendOffer
    -> reject "At least two completed interview feedback entries are required before extending an offer — only {FeedbackCount} so far"

from OfferExtended on AcceptOffer
    -> transition Hired

precept EventRegistration

# A conference or event attendee registration: the registrant fills in identity,
# seat count, and ticket price; submission moves them to PendingPayment; payment
# confirms the registration; check-in finalizes their arrival on event day.
#
# Free-Construction: the registrant enriches a Draft over time before submitting.
# Required-at-submit fields are declared optional and gated by the Register row's
# guard. A bulk discount (10+ seats) is applied inline via a conditional value.

# Registrant identity — filled progressively in Draft.
field RegistrantName as string optional maxlength 200
field ContactEmail as string optional maxlength 200

# Seat accounting — SeatsReserved is set by the registrant; TicketsIssued is
# minted at payment time and must match the reserved count.
field SeatsReserved as integer default 0 nonnegative max 100
field TicketsIssued as integer default 0 nonnegative max 100

# Pricing — money in 'USD' for exactness. AmountDue applies the 10+ seat bulk discount.
field PricePerSeat as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD'
field AmountDue as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD'

# Operational fields
field CancellationReason as string optional
field CheckInDesk as string optional maxlength 100

# Issued tickets cannot exceed reserved seats — the bulk discount is on price, not
# on entitlement; selling more tickets than seats would oversubscribe the event.
rule TicketsIssued <= SeatsReserved because "Issued tickets ({TicketsIssued}) cannot exceed reserved seats ({SeatsReserved}) — the event is capacity-constrained"

# States
state Draft initial
state PendingPayment
state Confirmed
state Cancelled terminal
state CheckedIn terminal

# CheckInDesk is meaningful only on the day of the event, when the registrant arrives.
in Draft, PendingPayment, Confirmed, Cancelled omit CheckInDesk

# Editable windows — the registrant fills the form in Draft; contact corrections
# are allowed after submission. Seat changes go through UpdateSeats so AmountDue
# stays consistent with seat count and the bulk-discount tier is reapplied.
in Draft modify RegistrantName, ContactEmail, SeatsReserved, PricePerSeat editable
in PendingPayment modify ContactEmail editable

# State ensures
in Confirmed ensure TicketsIssued == SeatsReserved because "A confirmed registration must issue one ticket per reserved seat — payment commits the entitlement"
in CheckedIn ensure CheckInDesk is set because "A checked-in registration must record the desk that processed arrival — for badge reissue and capacity reconciliation"

# Events
event Register
event UpdateSeats(Seats as integer positive max 100)
event RecordPayment
event Cancel(Reason as string optional)
event CheckIn(Desk as string notempty maxlength 100)

# Register — full intake must be on record. The 10+ seat bulk discount applies a
# 10% reduction to the line total.
from Draft on Register when RegistrantName is set and ContactEmail is set and SeatsReserved > 0 and PricePerSeat > '0.00 USD'
    -> set AmountDue = if SeatsReserved >= 10 then SeatsReserved * PricePerSeat * 0.9 else SeatsReserved * PricePerSeat
    -> transition PendingPayment
from Draft on Register
    -> reject "Registration requires a name, contact email, at least one seat, and a positive price per seat — incomplete forms cannot be submitted"

# Seat updates while pending payment recompute AmountDue and reset TicketsIssued
# (tickets aren't minted until payment lands).
from PendingPayment on UpdateSeats
    -> set SeatsReserved = UpdateSeats.Seats
    -> set TicketsIssued = 0
    -> set AmountDue = if UpdateSeats.Seats >= 10 then UpdateSeats.Seats * PricePerSeat * 0.9 else UpdateSeats.Seats * PricePerSeat
    -> no transition

# Payment confirms — tickets are minted to match reserved seats.
from PendingPayment on RecordPayment when SeatsReserved > 0
    -> set TicketsIssued = SeatsReserved
    -> transition Confirmed
from PendingPayment on RecordPayment
    -> reject "Payment cannot be recorded before any seats are reserved — the line total would be zero"

# Cancellation before payment — Draft or PendingPayment only. A Confirmed registration
# requires a refund process, which is out of scope here.
from Draft, PendingPayment on Cancel
    -> set CancellationReason = if Cancel.Reason is set then Cancel.Reason else "Cancelled by registrant — no reason given"
    -> transition Cancelled

# Check-in on event day.
from Confirmed on CheckIn
    -> set CheckInDesk = CheckIn.Desk
    -> transition CheckedIn

# or product line. A fee schedule holds the base price, the allowed discount

precept ClinicAppointmentScheduling

# A clinic appointment from scheduling through visit completion or cancellation.
# Constructor Pattern: an appointment cannot meaningfully exist without a patient
# and a specific time slot, so Schedule is the initial event and the appointment
# arrives in Scheduled fully formed. Reschedule moves the slot; check-in advances
# the lifecycle; completion or cancellation closes it.

# Patient identity and slot — established at construction and adjusted on reschedule.
field PatientName as string notempty maxlength 200
field ScheduledDay as integer nonnegative
field ScheduledMinute as integer nonnegative min 0 max 1439

# Operational flags
field ReminderSent as boolean default false
field CheckInNote as string optional
field CancellationReason as string optional

# Appointments must start on a 15-minute boundary throughout the lifecycle —
# both at construction and on every reschedule.
rule ScheduledMinute % 15 == 0 because "Appointment slot {ScheduledMinute} must start on a 15-minute boundary — clinic scheduling grid is 15-minute slots"

# States
state Scheduled initial
state CheckedIn
state Completed terminal
state Cancelled terminal

# Editable windows — the slot can be adjusted before the patient arrives.
in Scheduled modify ScheduledDay, ScheduledMinute editable

# Events
event Schedule(Name as string notempty maxlength 200, DayNumber as integer nonnegative, MinuteOfDay as integer nonnegative min 0 max 1439) initial
on Schedule ensure Schedule.MinuteOfDay % 15 == 0 because "Appointment slot {Schedule.MinuteOfDay} must start on a 15-minute boundary — clinic scheduling grid is 15-minute slots"

event Reschedule(DayNumber as integer nonnegative, MinuteOfDay as integer nonnegative min 0 max 1439)
on Reschedule ensure Reschedule.MinuteOfDay % 15 == 0 because "Appointment slot {Reschedule.MinuteOfDay} must start on a 15-minute boundary — clinic scheduling grid is 15-minute slots"

event SendReminder
event CheckIn(Note as string optional)
event CompleteVisit
event Cancel(Reason as string optional)

# Construction
on Schedule
    -> set PatientName = Schedule.Name
    -> set ScheduledDay = Schedule.DayNumber
    -> set ScheduledMinute = Schedule.MinuteOfDay

# Reschedule clears the reminder flag — the patient should be re-notified for the new slot.
from Scheduled on Reschedule
    -> set ScheduledDay = Reschedule.DayNumber
    -> set ScheduledMinute = Reschedule.MinuteOfDay
    -> set ReminderSent = false
    -> no transition

from Scheduled on SendReminder
    -> set ReminderSent = true
    -> no transition

from Scheduled on CheckIn
    -> set CheckInNote = if CheckIn.Note is set then CheckIn.Note else "No note recorded at check-in"
    -> transition CheckedIn

from Scheduled on Cancel
    -> set CancellationReason = if Cancel.Reason is set then Cancel.Reason else "No reason given"
    -> transition Cancelled

from CheckedIn on CompleteVisit
    -> transition Completed

precept MaintenanceWorkOrder

# A facilities work order — submitted by a requester, assigned to a technician,
# scheduled, executed, and completed. Demonstrates temporal types carrying
# scheduling and SLA semantics that plain numbers cannot: date for the due
# date, duration for estimated and actual labour with exact arithmetic, and
# duration <= duration enforcing an SLA overrun limit structurally.

# Identity and request data — established at submission.
field RequesterName as string notempty maxlength 200
field Location as string notempty maxlength 200
field IssueSummary as string notempty
field Urgent as boolean default false

# Scheduling — populated when an assignment is recorded.
field AssignedTechnician as string optional maxlength 200
field ScheduledDate as date optional
field EstimatedDuration as duration optional

# Progress and parts
field ActualDuration as duration default '0 hours'
field PartsApproved as boolean default false

# Completion and cancellation
field CompletionNote as string optional
field CancellationReason as string optional

# States — the work order begins in Open the moment intake completes.
state Open initial
state Scheduled
state InProgress
state Completed terminal
state Cancelled terminal

# State ensures
in Scheduled ensure AssignedTechnician is set because "Scheduled work must name the technician responsible for executing it"
in Scheduled ensure ScheduledDate is set because "Scheduled work must have a committed date — facilities scheduling fails without one"
in Completed ensure CompletionNote is set because "Completed work orders must carry the technician's completion note for audit and follow-up"

# Active work cannot finish without a technician — guards mid-flight reassignment loss.
from InProgress ensure AssignedTechnician is set because "Active work cannot finish without a technician on record"

# Events
event Submit(
    Requester as string notempty maxlength 200,
    WorkLocation as string notempty maxlength 200,
    Summary as string notempty,
    IsUrgent as boolean default false) initial

event Assign(
    Technician as string notempty maxlength 200,
    DueDate as date,
    Estimate as duration)
on Assign ensure Assign.Estimate > '0 hours' because "Estimated duration must be positive — a zero-hour estimate cannot be scheduled meaningfully"

event ApproveParts
event StartWork
event RecordProgress(Elapsed as duration)
on RecordProgress ensure RecordProgress.Elapsed > '0 hours' because "Progress entries must record a positive elapsed time — zero-hour entries add no information"

event Complete(Note as string notempty)
event Cancel(Reason as string optional)

# Construction — the requester submits an intake form; the work order is born Open.
on Submit
    -> set RequesterName = Submit.Requester
    -> set Location = Submit.WorkLocation
    -> set IssueSummary = Submit.Summary
    -> set Urgent = Submit.IsUrgent

# Assignment — facilities dispatches a technician with a date and estimate.
from Open on Assign
    -> set AssignedTechnician = Assign.Technician
    -> set ScheduledDate = Assign.DueDate
    -> set EstimatedDuration = Assign.Estimate
    -> transition Scheduled
from Open, Scheduled on Cancel
    -> set CancellationReason = Cancel.Reason
    -> transition Cancelled

# Parts approval and work start — urgent jobs cannot begin without parts in hand.
from Scheduled on ApproveParts
    -> set PartsApproved = true
    -> no transition
from Scheduled on StartWork when not Urgent or PartsApproved
    -> transition InProgress
from Scheduled on StartWork
    -> reject "Urgent work cannot start without approved parts — call ApproveParts first"

# Progress and completion — actual duration must stay within four hours of estimate.
from InProgress on RecordProgress
    -> set ActualDuration = ActualDuration + RecordProgress.Elapsed
    -> no transition
from InProgress on Complete when not EstimatedDuration is set or ActualDuration <= EstimatedDuration + '4 hours'
    -> set CompletionNote = Complete.Note
    -> transition Completed
from InProgress on Complete
    -> reject "Actual duration {ActualDuration} exceeds the estimate of {EstimatedDuration} by more than 4 hours — supervisor review required before completing"

precept SaasSubscriptionBilling

# A SaaS subscription record fed from the billing system. The subscription
# arrives Active with the customer, plan, and price set at construction.
# Payment lifecycle drives the state machine: a failed payment moves to
# PastDue; the customer can recover by paying or be expired by the dunning
# system; the customer can also cancel at any time. Renewal from Expired
# returns the entity to Active for a fresh billing period.

# Subscription identity — fixed at construction.
field SubscriptionId as string notempty maxlength 50
field CustomerId as string notempty maxlength 50
field CustomerName as string notempty maxlength 200
field PlanId as string notempty maxlength 50
field PlanName as choice of string("Free", "Basic", "Professional", "Enterprise") default "Free"
field BillingCycle as choice of string("Monthly", "Annual") default "Monthly"

# Pricing — money in 'USD' for exactness.
field Amount as money in 'USD' positive
field DiscountPercent as decimal default 0 nonnegative max 100 maxplaces 2 editable
field DiscountEndDate as instant optional editable

# Billing period
field CurrentPeriodStart as instant
field CurrentPeriodEnd as instant
field NextBillingDate as instant
field AutoRenew as boolean default true

# Payment tracking
field PaymentMethod as choice of string("CreditCard", "BankTransfer", "Invoice") optional
field LastPaymentDate as instant optional
field LastPaymentAmount as money in 'USD' optional
field LastPaymentStatus as choice of string("Success", "Failed", "Pending") optional
field OutstandingBalance as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD' nonnegative

field DaysPastDue as integer default 0 nonnegative

# Cancellation
field CancellationDate as instant optional
field CancellationReason as string optional

# Dunning window invariant — beyond 365 days, dunning must move to Expired.
rule DaysPastDue <= 365 because "A subscription cannot remain past-due longer than 365 days — the dunning system must transition to Expired before that"

# States — payment lifecycle.
state Active initial
state PastDue
state Expired
state Cancelled terminal

# State ensures — invariants the proof engine enforces per state.
in PastDue ensure OutstandingBalance > '0.00 USD' because "A past-due subscription must have an outstanding balance — without one, dunning has nothing to collect"
in Expired ensure DaysPastDue > 0 because "An expired subscription must have accumulated overdue days — expiry is the terminal outcome of unrecovered past-due"
in Cancelled ensure CancellationDate is set because "A cancelled subscription must record when cancellation took effect"

# Construction — subscription created by the billing system.
event Create(
    SubscriptionId as string notempty maxlength 50,
    CustomerId as string notempty maxlength 50,
    CustomerName as string notempty maxlength 200,
    PlanId as string notempty maxlength 50,
    PlanName as choice of string("Free", "Basic", "Professional", "Enterprise"),
    BillingCycle as choice of string("Monthly", "Annual"),
    Amount as money in 'USD' positive) initial

# Billing events
event ProcessPayment(PaymentAmount as money in 'USD' positive, PaymentMethod as choice of string("CreditCard", "BankTransfer", "Invoice"))
event PaymentSuccess(PaymentDate as instant, PaymentAmount as money in 'USD' positive)
event PaymentFailed(Reason as string notempty)
event CancelSubscription(Reason as string notempty)
event ExpireSubscription
event RenewSubscription(NewPeriodStart as instant, NewPeriodEnd as instant, NewAmount as money in 'USD' positive)

precept MedicalDeviceTracking

# A tracked medical device moves through its inventory lifecycle: registered
# into inventory, assigned to a patient, brought into use, accumulating
# usage hours that drive maintenance, returned and serviced, and eventually
# retired. A regulatory recall (FDA Class I, II, or III) is an override that
# can fire from any non-terminal state and immediately transitions to the
# terminal Recalled state. UDI (Unique Device Identifier), serial number,
# and manufacturer are required at registration for traceability and recall
# propagation (21 CFR Part 821). Assignment fields are omit in Available
# and MaintenanceRequired so they are structurally absent when the device
# is not assigned — no explicit clear actions are needed on the return
# transitions.

# Device identification — fixed at registration; required by FDA UDI rules.
field DeviceId as string notempty maxlength 50
field UdiDeviceIdentifier as string notempty maxlength 100  # FDA UDI per 21 CFR Part 830 — up to ~74 chars, 100 covers GS1/HIBCC/ICCBBA carrier variants
field SerialNumber as string notempty maxlength 100
field Manufacturer as string notempty maxlength 200
field ModelNumber as string optional maxlength 100
field DeviceCategory as choice of string("Infusion", "Monitor", "Ventilator", "Imaging", "Implantable", "WearableSensor", "Diagnostic")

# Assignment — set when transitioning to Assigned/InUse; omit in Available
# and MaintenanceRequired so the fields are structurally absent there.
field AssignedPatientId as string optional maxlength 50
field AssignedPatientName as string optional maxlength 200
field PrescribingProvider as string optional maxlength 200
field PrescriptionDate as date optional
field AssignedAt as instant optional

# Usage tracking — TotalUsageHours accumulates across all assignments;
# UsageHoursAtLastService captures the reading at the last service event.
field TotalUsageHours as integer nonnegative default 0
field UsageHoursAtLastService as integer nonnegative default 0
field UsageCycles as integer nonnegative default 0

# Maintenance — manufacturer-defined service interval; next-due date is
# tracked so an external scheduler can issue FlagForMaintenance.
field MaintenanceIntervalHours as integer positive default 500
field LastServiceDate as date optional
field NextServiceDueOn as date optional
field ServicedBy as string optional maxlength 200

# Recall — populated only on the terminal Recalled state. RecallClass uses
# FDA convention: Class1 = serious adverse health consequences/death;
# Class2 = temporary or reversible; Class3 = unlikely to cause harm.
field RecallClass as choice of string("Class1", "Class2", "Class3") optional
field RecallNoticeDate as date optional
field RecallReason as string optional

# Retirement — populated only on the terminal Retired state.
field RetirementReason as string optional
field RetiredAt as instant optional

# Audit trail.
field DeviceLog as log of string

# Invariants.
rule UsageHoursAtLastService <= TotalUsageHours because "Usage at last service ({UsageHoursAtLastService}h) cannot exceed total accumulated usage ({TotalUsageHours}h)"

# States — Available → Assigned → InUse → (MaintenanceRequired → Available)
# | Retired. Recalled is the terminal regulatory off-ramp from any
# non-terminal state.
state Available initial
state Assigned
state InUse
state MaintenanceRequired
state Retired terminal
state Recalled terminal

# Fields with no meaning outside assignment / outcome states.
in Available, MaintenanceRequired omit AssignedPatientId, AssignedPatientName, PrescribingProvider, PrescriptionDate, AssignedAt
in Available, Assigned, InUse, MaintenanceRequired omit RecallClass, RecallNoticeDate, RecallReason
in Available, Assigned, InUse, MaintenanceRequired, Recalled omit RetirementReason, RetiredAt

# State ensures.
in Assigned ensure AssignedPatientId is set because "An assigned device must record the patient it is assigned to"
in Assigned ensure PrescribingProvider is set because "An assigned device must record the prescribing provider"
in InUse ensure AssignedPatientId is set because "A device in use must remain associated with its patient"
in Retired ensure RetirementReason is set because "A retired device must record why it was taken out of service"
in Retired ensure RetiredAt is set because "A retired device must record when it was retired"
in Recalled ensure RecallReason is set because "A recalled device must record the manufacturer or FDA recall reason"
in Recalled ensure RecallClass is set because "A recalled device must record the FDA recall class"

# Construction — device is registered from the device-registration system.
event Create(
    DeviceId as string notempty maxlength 50,
    UdiDeviceIdentifier as string notempty maxlength 100,
    SerialNumber as string notempty maxlength 100,
    Manufacturer as string notempty maxlength 200,
    ModelNumber as string optional maxlength 100,
    DeviceCategory as choice of string("Infusion", "Monitor", "Ventilator", "Imaging", "Implantable", "WearableSensor", "Diagnostic"),
    MaintenanceIntervalHours as integer positive) initial

# Assignment.
event AssignToPatient(PatientId as string notempty maxlength 50, PatientName as string notempty maxlength 200, PrescribingProvider as string notempty maxlength 200, PrescriptionDate as date)
event ReturnFromPatient(Reason as string notempty)

# Usage lifecycle.
event StartUse
event LogUsage(AdditionalHours as integer positive)
event EndUse

# Maintenance.
event FlagForMaintenance(Reason as string notempty)
event CompleteMaintenance(Technician as string notempty maxlength 200, NextServiceDueOn as date, ServiceDate as date)

# Recall and retirement.
event IssueRecall(RecallClass as choice of string("Class1", "Class2", "Class3"), NoticeDate as date, Reason as string notempty)
event RetireDevice(Reason as string notempty)

# Construction row — opens in Available.
on Create
    -> set DeviceId = Create.DeviceId
    -> set UdiDeviceIdentifier = Create.UdiDeviceIdentifier
    -> set SerialNumber = Create.SerialNumber
    -> set Manufacturer = Create.Manufacturer
    -> set ModelNumber = Create.ModelNumber
    -> set DeviceCategory = Create.DeviceCategory
    -> set MaintenanceIntervalHours = Create.MaintenanceIntervalHours
    -> append DeviceLog "Device {Create.DeviceId} registered ({Create.Manufacturer} {Create.DeviceCategory})"

# Transitions

# Available → Assigned.
from Available on AssignToPatient
    -> set AssignedPatientId = AssignToPatient.PatientId
    -> set AssignedPatientName = AssignToPatient.PatientName
    -> set PrescribingProvider = AssignToPatient.PrescribingProvider
    -> set PrescriptionDate = AssignToPatient.PrescriptionDate
    -> set AssignedAt = now()
    -> append DeviceLog "Assigned to patient {AssignToPatient.PatientName} by {AssignToPatient.PrescribingProvider}"
    -> transition Assigned

# Assigned → InUse.
from Assigned on StartUse
    -> set UsageCycles = UsageCycles + 1
    -> append DeviceLog "Use started (cycle {UsageCycles})"
    -> transition InUse

# Assigned → Available — return without use. Assignment fields are omit in
# Available, so they become structurally absent on transition.
from Assigned on ReturnFromPatient
    -> append DeviceLog "Returned to inventory unused: {ReturnFromPatient.Reason}"
    -> transition Available

# InUse — same-state usage logging.
from InUse on LogUsage
    -> set TotalUsageHours = TotalUsageHours + LogUsage.AdditionalHours
    -> append DeviceLog "Usage logged: +{LogUsage.AdditionalHours}h (total {TotalUsageHours}h)"
    -> no transition

# InUse → MaintenanceRequired — explicit flag.
from InUse on FlagForMaintenance
    -> append DeviceLog "Flagged for maintenance: {FlagForMaintenance.Reason}"
    -> transition MaintenanceRequired

# InUse → MaintenanceRequired — usage threshold crossed.
from InUse on EndUse when TotalUsageHours - UsageHoursAtLastService >= MaintenanceIntervalHours
    -> append DeviceLog "Use ended; maintenance due ({TotalUsageHours}h total, {UsageHoursAtLastService}h at last service)"
    -> transition MaintenanceRequired

# InUse → Available — end of use, no maintenance required.
from InUse on EndUse
    -> append DeviceLog "Use ended; returned to inventory"
    -> transition Available

# MaintenanceRequired → Available.
from MaintenanceRequired on CompleteMaintenance
    -> set ServicedBy = CompleteMaintenance.Technician
    -> set LastServiceDate = CompleteMaintenance.ServiceDate
    -> set NextServiceDueOn = CompleteMaintenance.NextServiceDueOn
    -> set UsageHoursAtLastService = TotalUsageHours
    -> append DeviceLog "Maintenance completed by {CompleteMaintenance.Technician} on {CompleteMaintenance.ServiceDate}"
    -> transition Available

# Recall — regulatory override from any non-terminal state.
from Available, Assigned, InUse, MaintenanceRequired on IssueRecall
    -> set RecallClass = IssueRecall.RecallClass
    -> set RecallNoticeDate = IssueRecall.NoticeDate
    -> set RecallReason = IssueRecall.Reason
    -> append DeviceLog "Recall issued ({IssueRecall.RecallClass}): {IssueRecall.Reason}"
    -> transition Recalled

# Retirement — from inventory states only (Available or MaintenanceRequired).
from Available, MaintenanceRequired on RetireDevice
    -> set RetirementReason = RetireDevice.Reason
    -> set RetiredAt = now()
    -> append DeviceLog "Device retired: {RetireDevice.Reason}"
    -> transition Retired
